assertions: He should and will purchase Master B.'s houses, including the house in the Strand in which he lives — the bargain will be perfected, not fall through

He shall deal successfully with the seller: the seller will be tractable and come to terms with him, the seller's significator being strongly placed in the 7th and the lord of the 7th being also lord of the 11th, Lilly's hopes
The seller's first demand of £530 will not be the final settled price in its full rigour — the price will be moderated/abated by negotiation below that first demand

Near段 difficulty is bargaining and money, not refusal: the Moon translating light by a square out of signs of long ascension gives friction that works like a trine, so apparent hard terms resolve into agreement
His own money cannot be had at once — Mercury, lord of his 2nd, retrograde — it is locked up and cannot be called in immediately, consistent with the stated six months

He will nevertheless procure money in time to pay for the purchase: payment will be accommodated in time, by the seller giving respite/time and by money becoming available, rather than requiring the whole sum in ready cash at once

The houses themselves are worth buying: Saturn, lord of the 4th, has no material debility except retrogradation and cadency — the property/title is substantially sound, the defect is only slowness and delay in completion
Completion belongs to a scale of months, not days — tied to the period in which his money can be called in, up to about the six months named in the context
method: Horary astrology — Lilly, Christian Astrology classical rules (significators of querent, seller/7th, houses/4th and money/2nd; reception, application and translation of light)
reasoning: Venus applying to a trine of Saturn, lord of the 4th (the houses), is an easy perfection between a benefic and the quesited property; the Sun, seller's significator, is locally placed in the 7th and received, and lord of the 7th is also lord of the 11th (hopes), so seller and hope coincide. The Moon translates light by square out of signs of long ascension, which Lilly counts as operating like a trine — difficulty that still perfects the matter. Against this, Mercury lord of the 2nd retrograde and Saturn retrograde/cadent show only the money and completion being slow and locked up for months, not denial; Saturn otherwise without material debility leaves the houses themselves sound. Hence two-stage judgment: near段 hard bargaining and unavailable cash, far段 agreement, abated/moderated price and money procured in time on a months scale (unit: months, path: money becoming callable within the stated six-month period and seller allowing time).
summary: Yes — he will buy the houses on moderated terms and will procure the money in time, despite his own money being temporarily locked up.
